description.zh: 需要删除的Bucket名称，仅支持单个删除。
description.en: The name of the bucket to delete. Only one bucket can be deleted at a time.

descriptions.zh:
- 只有Bucket的阿里云UID账户拥有者才能删除其账号下的Bucket。

- Bucket中存储文件时不能删除，只能删除空的Bucket空间。
descriptions.en:
- Only the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the bucket can delete it.

- A bucket must be empty before it can be deleted.
